fixed_input_rationale: Token 1000 defines the v2 release envelope and is distinct from historical token-17 artifacts; independent atomic-reduction replay token equality is diagnostic rather than assumed.

diagnostic_rationale.elementwise_allclose_rtol_atol: A single rtol/atol pair is less specific than the versioned per-tensor max/mean envelopes.
diagnostic_rationale.eager_graph_bit_exact: BF16 atomic-add reduction order can differ between eager and CUDA Graph launches even when dependencies and output tokens are correct.
diagnostic_rationale.eager_vs_persistent_tensor_envelope: The split eager path and persistent VM use different atomic schedules; their versioned envelope is recorded as cross-implementation evidence rather than a dependency gate.
diagnostic_rationale.graph_vs_persistent_tensor_envelope: The PDL graph and persistent VM use different atomic schedules; their versioned envelope is recorded as cross-implementation evidence rather than a dependency gate.
diagnostic_rationale.graph_matches_persistent_replay_token: The graph and independent persistent replay each contain atomic reductions; their argmax equality is recorded but not used as the dependency oracle.
diagnostic_rationale.persistent_initial_vs_replay_token: Independent persistent atomic replays can diverge near a low-margin argmax; their tensor differences and token equality are recorded as cross-implementation diagnostics rather than dependency gates.
